translationRepairs: Wula Na was notoriously corrupt, squeezed his subordinates for bribes, and winked at foreign pirates, whose vessels clustered outside the Wuhu Gate unchecked.
Wula Na was notoriously corrupt, squeezed his subordinates for bribes, and winked at foreign pirates, whose vessels clustered outside the Five Tiger Gate unchecked.
s0008 has 五虎門, the coastal Five Tiger Gate near Fuzhou; Wuhu Gate wrongly evokes 蕪湖 and is a clear mistranslation.
He sent agents to verify the facts and punished Yisang’a by law.
An imperial commissioner was sent to verify the facts, and Yisang’a was punished by law.
After Chu’s 途次劾 in s0086, s0087’s 遣使勘實，置伊桑阿於法 is the throne sending investigators and punishing by law, not Chu dispatching his own agents.
